question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. 

Excruciating
solution:
The correct answer is **"Piercing "** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's learn the meaning of the given synonyms:

__
 
• **Excruciating - **very embarrassing, awkward, or tedious.
 
• **Piercing - ** having or showing shrewdness or keen intelligence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here we will see the meaning of the other given synonyms:

 
• **Facile -** ignoring the true complexities of an issue; superficial.
 
• **Enticing - **attractive or tempting; alluring.
 
• **Alluring - **powerfully and mysteriously attractive or fascinating; seductive.
